title: How is Hitler connected to Mr. Rogers?
description: Four real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Mr. Rogers, through a Bulgarian tsar, his boy-king son and a president.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Mr. Rogers?
fun_fact: Simeon became Bulgaria's tsar at six in 1943. He and the Dalai Lama are the last two living people who were heads of state during World War II.
research_note: Boris III's son Simeon, Bulgaria's boy king in 1943, came home from exile to be elected prime minister in 2001, which carries the line from Hitler's wartime ally to the Oval Office; the National Archives print of Hitler and Boris was used because the free 1941 photo cuts Hitler's face off at the edge.

image.credit: Heinrich Hoffmann; US National Archives (NARA 242-HB-48400-100), via US Holocaust Memorial Museum

links.line: In the early 1940s, Hitler hosted his ally, Bulgaria's Tsar Boris III.
In 1938, Boris posed with his baby son, Simeon, a future king.

image.file: File:President George W. Bush welcomes Simeon Saxe-Coburg Gotha, Prime Minister of the Republic of Bulgaria.jpg

links.line: In 2003, a grown-up Simeon met George W. Bush as Bulgaria's prime minister.

image.file: File:President George W. Bush Presents the Presidential Medal of Freedom Award to Fred Rogers.jpg

links.line: And a year earlier, Bush hung the Medal of Freedom on Mister Rogers.
